evals.prompt: revisa en profundidad si este proyecto cumple EU AI Act 2026
evals.expected_output: Structured audit report identifying Deporbot as limited-risk AI system (Claude via OpenRouter), classifying org as deployer, flagging Art. 50 transparency gaps, GDPR intersection issues, and providing prioritized remediation with file:line references
expectations: Identifies Deporbot / the chat assistant as an AI system
Identifies Claude Sonnet via OpenRouter as the model used
Classifies the AI system as limited risk (Art. 50)
Classifies the organization's role as deployer (not provider)
Flags the AI disclosure as insufficient for Art. 50(1) — the 10px footer text is not prominent enough
Flags that the privacy policy does not mention the AI chatbot or data processing through AI
Flags international data transfers to OpenRouter/Anthropic (US servers) as undocumented
References specific files and line numbers in findings
Includes a Sources section with regulatory URLs
Uses the structured report format with sections: AI Systems, Risk Classification, Compliance Status, Findings, Summary
